references.text: God predicts to Abraham that his descendants will be strangers in a land that is not theirs for 400 years, which corresponds to the stay in Egypt.
The prophecy that the fourth generation shall return, linked to the period the Israelites spent in Egypt.
God tells Jacob that he must go down to Egypt and become a great nation there, marking the beginning of the stay in Egypt.
Stephen refers to God's word that Abraham's descendants would be strangers in a foreign land and be oppressed for 400 years.
Paul mentions that the law came 430 years after the promise to Abraham, which corresponds to the period mentioned in Exod 12:40.
